India-US Leaders Discuss Trade, Defence, and Strategic Ties

Prime Minister Narendra Modi and U.S. President Donald Trump held discussions on trade, defense, and energy, agreeing to deepen their strategic partnership. The trade negotiations have entered their final stages, with the leaders expected to speak again soon. The talks aimed to advance bilateral relations between the two nations.
